description: This file declares an interface for providing adapters related to 'thing search' commands within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It specifies a method to retrieve a search command adapter, parameterized by a signal type.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: An interface that provides a method to retrieve a search command adapter for a specific signal type.

methods.name: getSearchCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for search commands of the specified signal type.
